svg.title: Firestore paths compared to Postgres tables
svg.desc: On the left, Firestore documents nested in paths: a task lives inside a project, inside a workspace, and stores an array of attachment IDs and a copy of its creator. On the right, Postgres tables workspaces, projects, tasks, attachments and task_attachments, connected by foreign keys.
svg.text: ↑ IDs in an array, and a copy of the user
The relationship is a column, and it's enforced
Arrows are foreign keys. task_attachments replaces the array.
